items.name: Aerospace & Defense segment backlog, Q2 2026
items.claim: MISTRAS Group describes demand in its Aerospace & Defense segment as temporarily outpacing capacity, supported by a healthy backlog, and is investing to expand in-lab testing capacity.
items.source_excerpt: Within A&D, demand is temporarily outpacing capacity, supported by a healthy backlog, strong customer relationships, and the mission-critical nature of the work, and we are investing meaningfully to expand capacity in our in-lab testing operations, with a particular focus on automation and throughput with a target to increase capacity.

notes: Q2/H1 2026 results release describes A&D segment backlog qualitatively; no dollar backlog figure disclosed anywhere in the stored release.
